title: Small Business Academy
seo_title: Small Business Academy in Springfield, MO – Dec 15
description: Small Business Academy is a free monthly session where business owners and professionals hear practical advice from industry professionals on a different topic each time, such as marketing strategies, financial management, and industry trends and technology. Attendees can connect with one another in a relaxed setting, and appetizers, entrees, and happy hour specials are available at the restaurant; bring a notepad, pen, and business cards. It takes place Tuesday, December 15, 2026 (Time TBD) at Big Whiskey's American Restaurant & Bar, 1550 E Battlefield St, Springfield, MO.
